tabs.label: Direct Input Entry
tabs.savedMdx:
SELECT {TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({[OPX Month].[OPX Month].Members}, 0)} ON COLUMNS,
       NON EMPTY CrossJoin({TM1FILTERBYLEVEL({[OPX Cost Center].[OPX Cost Center].Members}, 0)}, {[OPX Account].[OPX Account].[6000 Salaries], [OPX Account].[OPX Account].[6100 Travel], [OPX Account].[OPX Account].[6200 Supplies], [OPX Account].[OPX Account].[6300 Rent], [OPX Account].[OPX Account].[6400 Software], [OPX Account].[OPX Account].[6500 Misc]}) ON ROWS
FROM [OPX OPEX]
WHERE ([OPX Version].[OPX Version].[Forecast], [OPX Subsidiary].[OPX Subsidiary].[North], [OPX OPEX Measure].[OPX OPEX Measure].[Direct Input])

tabs.label: Fully Loaded Cost
